description: Windows privacy and isolation tool with process protection, file access controls, and network filtering.
pre_install: if (-not (is_admin)) { error "Administrator rights are required to install $app. Use an elevated PowerShell session."; return }
pre_uninstall: if (-not (is_admin)) { error "Administrator rights are required to uninstall $app. Use an elevated PowerShell session."; return }
notes: Installer engine: Detect It Easy 3.21 identified this exact release asset as Inno Setup Module 6.3.0 in KiroBucket workflow run 41903467568. The downloaded file's SHA-256 matched the manifest and its Authenticode signature was Valid.

This is a Nonportable installation candidate. The vendor's normal install path invokes PrivacyAgent.exe -install and starts the PrivacyAgent Windows service. The application depends on its service/kernel isolation component, so extracting the Inno payload alone is not an equivalent installation.

The x64 setup also runs its bundled VC_redist.x64.exe with /q /norestart. Installing or updating MajorPrivacy may therefore change the system-wide Visual C++ runtime state. Administrator rights are required.

Scoop passes /DIR="$dir" so the program files and Inno uninstaller are placed inside the versioned Scoop app directory. The manifest disables the vendor DesktopIcon and AutoStartEntry tasks and creates a Scoop-managed Start Menu shortcut instead.

The vendor uninstaller runs PrivacyAgent.exe -remove before deleting the application files. The exact install, service lifecycle, update from an existing Scoop version, uninstall-after-update, and service cleanup have not been exercised on Windows yet. Keep this manifest under review until those checks pass.
